decision.explanation: Both awards are explicitly stated in the provided documents. Document d1 (D1S3 and D1S15) describes Jean Marc Dalpé receiving the title of Knight of the Order of the Dannebrog from the Danish Ambassador. Document d2 (D2S19) states that he received the Governor General's Award for French-language drama in 1994 for his play 'Le chien.' These are two distinct awards from separate sources and refer to the same individual.
